entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I'm calling because I need to return my VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I hope it's not too late.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I get your full name and order number, please?
Of course. It's Maria Garcia, and the order number is VF551984.
Thank you, Maria. I see the order here, delivered on December 29th. So I can best assist you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it works fine. It's just... I really `changed my mind`. It was a bit of an `impulse buy` right after the holidays, and honestly, I just `don't use it`. I feel so bad about it, and I could really use that money back for some other things. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a long time.
I understand completely. Thank you for clarifying that for me. Let me just check the return eligibility for your order. One moment.

Okay, thanks for your patience. I've pulled up our policy, and it looks like you're all set. Our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery, and you're only on day 26, so you are unfortunately outside the window.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was going to be stuck with it. Thank you so, so much.

You're very welcome, Maria. I'm happy I could resolve this for you. I've just initiated the return in our system, and I've sent a prepaid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just place the device back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at any post office. You'll see the refund processed in about 3 to 5 business days after we receive it.
That's perfect. You've really made my day, Alex. Thank you!
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that was it. Thanks again!
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
